reuse.why: Simplifies getScheduledAmount and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold in schedule-template, but api-models re-implements the missing/number/range dispatch inline instead of calling getScheduledAmount.

duplication.why: scheduleModel.toExternal copies the null/number/range ternary and its own Math.min range rule next to the shared helper that already does exactly this.

placement.why: The range rule sits in shared/schedules.ts, but the approximate-amount worst-case rule is bolted onto the budget template call site instead of the shared expected-amount helper, so forecast, posting, preview and the API never apply it.

scope.why: Focused on the amount rule and the API field; removing the now-unused rounding option is a justified cleanup.

maintainability.why: The expected-amount rule is now split across getScheduledAmount, an inline approx adjustment in schedule-template and a hand-written copy in api-models, so the next rule change must find three places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/api-models.ts scheduleModel.toExternal (expectedAmount) and packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList (isapprox adjustment outside getScheduledAmount)

disguised_duplication.where: api-models.ts expectedAmount reshapes getScheduledAmount's dispatch as an inline ternary with Math.min

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount itself loses its rounding parameter, but api-models.ts re-implements it and schedule-template.ts applies the approximate tolerance around it rather than inside it
